title: Distance Between Bus Stops
description: Find the shortest distance between two bus stops in a circular route.
pseudocode:
1. total = sum(distance)
2. path = sum(distance[min(start, end) : max(start, end)])
3. return min(path, total - path)

steps.note: Calculate the total distance of the circular route.
Calculate distance going clockwise from start 0 to end 2.
Compare clockwise distance (3) with counter-clockwise distance (10-3=7) and return the minimum.
